note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated customs/B-L records with destination, HS code and BOL number exist, including a non-Nepal destination (Kenya, Mombasa, 2025-07-11). Declared HS 847420 (crushing/grinding machinery) is broadly consistent with the observed spares trade under HS 84749000 (parts of machines of 8474) and one row under 73181900 (threaded bolts) — no HS correction needed at this stage, though the 73181900 row is a fastener classification. Domestic supply evidence could not be verified: thecompanycheck.com and zaubacorp.com returned HTTP 403, Google/Bing/DuckDuckGo returned no usable results or timed out, so GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders and annual-report splits are all null — not public to me in this session, not evidence of absence. Revenue and export volume figures: null (not disclosed on the free customs view; not invented). Role: appears to be a manufacturer of crusher/spares (own product names KCC-750, KCC-1200 series) selling to Nepal and Kenya distributors — manufacturer, not a pure trader, but this is inferred from product naming, not from a registry.
